results.q: I can't log into my Circles account, what should I do?
results.a: First make sure your cellular data plan is active, or that you have access to a Wi-Fi connection with internet access. Then, try refreshing the https://www.circlesubi.id page in your phone's browser. If that still doesn't work contact your local Circles Support Officer.

results.q: I often get logged out Circles without meaning to, what can I do?
results.a: If you change your phone or use a different web browser you will need to log in again. This happens mostly when you e.g. open circles via a link from a different application like a messenger and then open it again in your regular browser like chrome, safari or firefox.

results.q: I forgot my Circles PIN, what should I do?
results.a: Click on "Forgot your pin?" and follow the instructions on screen.

results.q: I would like to reactivate my Circles Shop now, how do I do that?
results.a:
If you previously deactivated your shop, or it was deactivated by Circles due to Circles Market Shop Policy violation, once it is ready to be reactivated you can easily do so. 




Before you reactivate a shop, please first ensure it has a clear offering for appropriate goods and services to exchange for Circles Points.




To reactivate your shop, follow these steps:

From your shop account, open your PROFILE.

Choose EDIT SHOP from the menu.

Tick ACTIVATE SHOP.

results.q: What happens to Circles User accounts if they aren't used regularly?
results.a:
Circles reserve the right to delete inactive Circles accounts, and if your account remains inactive (in other words you don't do any Circles exchanges) for 3 months or more it may be deleted from the system.




To prevent this from happening to your Circles account, just log in and start exchanging Circles Points with goods & services offered by people you trust!

results.q: Can I create a new Circles account after mine has been deleted?
results.a:
Yes! You can always sign up for a new Circles account. Go to https://app.CirclesUBI.id to register your Circles account.




If you have any issues with this process feel free to reach out to the Circles Helpline
